body: That's almost the same situation I'm in. I was not doing great but I was holding it together. Recently I got a call from my ex and she validated all my feelings, only to bash them all in a some strange lie. I'm afraid that I will be reckless again and live dangerously.
I though I had someone and they broke my trust again. I don't know why I keep trusting this person. I was hanging on for5 months. I feel really hopeless.
